name: Outlaw Tools v0.6.3
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.6.3

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.6.3

## Saved Loadouts

- Add a separate Delete saved plan action for saved FPS and ship loadouts, with confirmation. The existing Shopping List Remove action remains separate.
- Put Edit loadout alongside Delete in Saved Plans. Open the matching fitting editor and save changes to the existing plan without creating a duplicate.
- Keep inventory, Shopping List entries and other saved plans unchanged when deleting a loadout. Preserve open fitting drafts while detaching their deleted saved-plan identity.
- Refuse deletion if the selected record or player profile changes before the operation, and keep database work off the desktop UI thread.

## Known Limitations

- Existing refinery OCR and large-profile limitations remain: review scanned values, and large-profile operations may cause intermittent UI pauses. Automatic cross-PC sync is not included.
- Older assignment-only equipment records without a fitting tree remain read-only; unavailable or malformed records are not automatically converted into fittings.

## Downloads

- Windows: `OutlawTools-Setup-0.6.3.exe` and SHA-256 checksum.
- Linux: `OutlawTools-linux-x86_64-0.6.3.tar.gz` and SHA-256 checksum.
